box_addressed: P3 — Bootstrap/aggregate by ontology pair or track, not correspondence row.

rule.statement: Every P3 aggregate, bootstrap, confidence interval and p value must take an ontology pair, a track, or a case as its unit. Correspondence rows within a case are not independent samples and must never be resampled or counted as such.
rule.why: Correspondences inside one ontology pair share the seed ontology, the label vocabulary, the reference-alignment construction and the matcher's own decision threshold. Treating them as independent inflates n by orders of magnitude and manufactures significance that the case count cannot support. One pair with 91 correspondences is n=1, not n=91.

fails_closed_on: a population estimand whose declared unit is not in admissible_analysis_units
a confidence interval or p value reported when the case count is below the declared minimum
a resample/bootstrap whose unit is a correspondence row or pair cell
an aggregate that declares no unit at all

exit_codes.3: interval or p value reported below the minimum case count

precedent_this_rule_freezes.quoted_discipline: The analysis unit is one public OAEI 2004 test-103 case. Pair cells are not treated as independent samples, so no population estimand, confidence interval or p value is reported.
precedent_this_rule_freezes.successor_prohibition: no pair cell treated as an independent case
precedent_this_rule_freezes.note: V21 stated and obeyed this rule in prose and V22 re-froze it as a prohibited promotion. This artifact adds the missing third thing: a checker that fails closed when a future P3 report breaks it.

box_verdict.box: Bootstrap/aggregate by ontology pair or track, not correspondence row.
box_verdict.how: The rule is stated, its unit taxonomy is closed, it is bound to the V21 precedent by hash, and it is mechanically enforced by a fail-closed checker with a CANNOT_CHECK exit distinct from PASS.
box_verdict.not_claimed: That any aggregate has been computed. No result is created by this artifact.
